title: Euclidean coefficient-norm duality for unit simple n-vectors (Cauchy–Binet)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ L : MultiVector P n →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ covectorEuclideanNorm (L ξ) ≤ 1 ∧ ξ (L ξ) = 1
